notes.note: Post-foundation merge scoped review: compared this entry point's personal Station, phone pairing and account/sharing links with the deployment-authentication guide delta. That delta corrects the existing opt-in native Device-proof allowlist for exact relay-management and Project-access leaves. The current nativeDeviceProofPilotRoute explicitly enumerates those leaves; they retain separate management grants and account/Project checks. Ordinary one-time host sign-in, pairing invitations and first-chat steps are unchanged. This source review is not native pilot, physical phone, passkey or released-install qualification.
